# pve_realm_sync (Action)

Syncs users and/or groups from the configured LDAP/AD directory into `user.cfg` (`POST /access/domains/{realm}/sync`) and waits for the sync task to finish. Synced groups are named `name-$realm`, so make sure those groups do not already exist to prevent overwriting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Preview (dry run) what a full sync of the corporate LDAP realm would
# change, removing vanished entries and their ACLs. Invoke with:
#   apply it from a resource lifecycle block: actions = [action.pve_realm_sync.preview]
action "pve_realm_sync" "preview" {
  config {
    realm           = "corp"
    scope           = "both"
    dry_run         = true
    enable_new      = true
    remove_vanished = "entry;acl"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `realm` (String) Authentication domain ID to sync.

### Optional

- `dry_run` (Boolean) If set, does not write anything.
- `enable_new` (Boolean) Enable newly synced users immediately. Defaults to `true`.
- `full` (Boolean) Deprecated upstream: use `remove_vanished` instead. When set, the directory is the source of truth: users/groups not returned are deleted and locally modified properties of synced users are reset.
- `purge` (Boolean) Deprecated upstream: use `remove_vanished` instead. Removes ACLs for users or groups removed from the config during the sync.
- `remove_vanished` (String) A semicolon-separated list of things to remove when they vanish during the sync: `entry` removes the user/group when not returned from the sync, `properties` removes properties of existing users/groups missing in the source, `acl` removes ACLs of vanished users/groups. `none` (the default) disables all removals, e.g. `entry;acl`.
- `scope` (String) Select what to sync. Must be one of `users`, `groups`, `both`.
